_about: The console's response headers (CONSOLE.md §5.1): the one source. The agent's dev server sends them on the demo (agent/deets_agent/security_headers.py); Vite sends the page's with the dev changes (console/vite.config.ts); the deploy reads this file too. The server adds `report-uri` with its own base path. A null in `dev` drops that directive.
